items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Him and I and Black Benny work together.

ctx.x: Willie Humphrey, I'll talk to Corsier.

And he could hear me playing over there and he'd tell Willie Humphrey, he'd tell the fellow, come down and say, he's going to bust a vessel in his neck. You see Willie Humphrey, anytime you meet him, just ask him that word. Him and I and Black Benny work together. Years, that he liked.
I've heard a lot of people talk about that. Well, what's more to get back to Johnny Dogg.
